Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly analyzed the information provided by the WebSurfer and misclassified the elements in the sets. Specifically, the Planner concluded that Set A (iodine, iron, nickel) contains only metals, despite iodine being a nonmetal. Furthermore, the Planner failed to identify that Set C (sodium, phosphorus, copper) was the correct answer due to a misclassification of phosphorus as a metal. This error in analysis and classification led to the wrong solution to the problem.
